answer: Give every identity a public work history that acts as a mirror: anyone can see which funding source an identity reflects. New identities start at the foot of the summit with zero weight and climb only through completed, peer-verified work. A sudden gale of fresh identities all mirroring one funder is visible on-ledger, so the network discounts their weight as one correlated cluster. Sybils cannot hide their shared origin, and manufacturing distinct histories costs real work per identity.
